risks.riskTitle: Lead creation loses account and business creation
risks.exactVariableOrState: createAuthUser, socialUid, restaurantId, leadPayload, restPayload, userBootstrapPayload, ownerPatch
risks.whyItIsRisky: Lead save creates or updates leads, restaurants, public meta and users, and can create a Firebase auth user. Moving only the visible lead form would drop hidden provisioning side effects.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A new lead appears incomplete, business login fails, public business page is missing, or owner fields are empty.

risks.riskTitle: Lead to Customer conversion loses restaurant/user linkage
risks.exactVariableOrState: lead.restaurantId, restaurantId, socialUid, socialEmail, state.leads.convertingIds, state.customers.items
risks.whyItIsRisky: Conversion writes restaurant, user and lead documents and updates both lead and customer state. A partial move can mark a lead as customer without a usable restaurant or user link.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Converted customer cannot log in, customer is missing from Customers, or the lead remains visible with stale status.

risks.riskTitle: Coordinates and map data are not written
risks.exactVariableOrState: state.leadModal.coords, state.leadModal.locations, state.staff.form.coords, lat, lng, gpsLat, gpsLng, plusCode
risks.whyItIsRisky: The map picker and coordinate writes are split across CRM runtime, lead save, lead conversion and staff save.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Lead/customer/staff records save without map coordinates or show the wrong address/location later.

risks.riskTitle: Staff assignment and CEO scope are not preserved
risks.exactVariableOrState: state.leads.scope, state.customers.scope, assignedStaffId, createdByStaffId, ceoParentUid, ceoRootUid, ceoPath
risks.whyItIsRisky: CRM scope combines CEO identity, known ownership overrides, staff hierarchy and lead/customer scope filters.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A staff member sees or edits the wrong leads/customers, or CEO scoped lists show missing/wrong records.

risks.riskTitle: Customers write the wrong restaurants document
risks.whyItIsRisky: Customer save writes restaurants/{customer.id} and can create/update a linked lead depending on status.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Editing one customer changes another business, status changes create duplicate leads, or public meta points at the wrong restaurant.

risks.riskTitle: Routes break because activeTab still expects social-app handling
risks.whyItIsRisky: /leads, /staff, /customers and /business-accounts currently map to social-app tabs and vercel.json rewrites them to the social app.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Direct links to CRM routes show a blank page, wrong tab, or normal social shell instead of Heart/Admin.

risks.riskTitle: Events and buttons remain bound in the old app shell
risks.whyItIsRisky: CRM buttons are bound from the social app event path. Moving markup without moving bind ownership leaves controls inert.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Lead/customer/staff buttons render but clicks, search, filters, save or delete do nothing.

risks.riskTitle: Modals and forms are missing after migration
risks.whyItIsRisky: Lead and customer modals are rendered and bound through shared overlay orchestration, not only from list rows.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Editing a lead/customer opens no modal, opens stale data, or save buttons are missing.

risks.riskTitle: social-app.js still imports CRM after move
risks.exactVariableOrState: CRM_LAZY_RENDERERS_MODULE_URL, loadLeads, loadCustomers, loadCeoStaff, saveLeadFromModal, convertLeadToCustomer
risks.whyItIsRisky: Leaving imports in social-app keeps CRM in the normal startup path even if visible routes move.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Normal social app startup remains heavy or has hidden CRM failures in Feed/Search/Map paths.

risks.riskTitle: Heart/Admin loads without required CRM dependencies
risks.exactVariableOrState: CRM runtime dependencies not present in Heart files inspected
risks.whyItIsRisky: Heart currently has no verified CRM loaders, Firebase write facade, modal binders, lazy renderer loader or auth/profile repair path.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Heart route loads, but Leads/Staff/Customers are missing, blank, or fail at first data action.

risks.riskTitle: Public V1 routes are accidentally affected
risks.exactVariableOrState: reserved public route segments, vercel.json rewrites
risks.whyItIsRisky: CRM segments are reserved from public business routing while public profile/menu/QR/cart/orders must stay untouched.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Public restaurant links, menus, QR flows, carts or orders stop resolving correctly.

risks.riskTitle: Lead delete drops public and social cleanup behavior
risks.whyItIsRisky: Lead delete deletes the lead and hides/deletes linked restaurant/public meta, then purges or deactivates related social/business records.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Deleted leads leave public restaurants visible, stale social content remains, or business users can still access deleted accounts.

risks.riskTitle: Business account access writes wrong restaurant staff scope
risks.exactVariableOrState: restaurantId, managedRestaurantId, businessOwnerUid, permissions, staffRestaurantId, waiterRestaurantId
risks.whyItIsRisky: Business accounts are business-owner scoped and write both restaurant staff subdocs and users docs.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: Staff users get access to the wrong restaurant, lose waiter/business permissions, or cannot log in.

risks.riskTitle: Auth profile bootstrap no longer repairs lead/business linkage
risks.whyItIsRisky: Auth profile loading can discover a lead by uid/email, ensure a restaurant for that lead and patch business profile state.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: A business user signs in but has no restaurant profile, no business account access, or no public landing linkage.

risks.riskTitle: CRM count deltas are lost or double-applied
risks.whyItIsRisky: Lead create, convert, delete and customer status changes update CRM counts through a shared count runtime.
risks.userVisibleSymptom: CEO/staff dashboards show wrong lead/customer totals after saves, deletes or conversions.
